text: You are building a wooden bookshelf in the garage. Your neighbor walks in to borrow a hammer. They offer to hold the boards steady while you drive the nails.
You are building a wooden bookshelf in the garage. Your neighbor walks in to borrow a hammer. They grab the tool from the bench without asking and walk out.
You are building a wooden bookshelf in the garage. Your neighbor walks in to borrow a hammer. They point at your joints and state the wood quality is extremely poor.
You are building a wooden bookshelf in the garage. Your neighbor walks in to borrow a hammer. They take the tool, say a brief word of thanks, and leave.
You are painting a landscape on a large canvas. Someone approaches your easel from behind. They offer a gentle remark about your use of color and shading.
You are painting a landscape on a large canvas. Someone approaches your easel from behind. They glance briefly at the canvas and walk away without speaking.
You are painting a landscape on a large canvas. Someone approaches your easel from behind. They point out mistakes in your perspective and shake their head at your work.
You are painting a landscape on a large canvas. Someone approaches your easel from behind. They stand and watch for a moment before moving on their way.
You are knitting a scarf on the porch. A passerby stops near the steps. They give a nod and say the pattern looks extremely intricate.
You are knitting a scarf on the porch. A passerby stops near the steps. They stare blankly at your hands for a second, then keep walking.
You are knitting a scarf on the porch. A passerby stops near the steps. They point at the yarn color and tell you it looks entirely outdated.
You are knitting a scarf on the porch. A passerby stops near the steps. They nod in your direction, fix their coat, and continue on their way.
You are fixing a broken bicycle chain on the sidewalk. A neighbor pauses next to you. They crouch down beside you and offer to help hold the bicycle pedals.
You are fixing a broken bicycle chain on the sidewalk. A neighbor pauses next to you. They step around you to avoid the grease and do not make eye contact.
You are fixing a broken bicycle chain on the sidewalk. A neighbor pauses next to you. They shake their head and claim you are just making the problem worse.
You are fixing a broken bicycle chain on the sidewalk. A neighbor pauses next to you. They wait for you to move your repair tools so they can walk past.
You are writing code on your laptop at a cafe. The person at the next table leans over. They politely ask what project you are working on so intently right now.
You are writing code on your laptop at a cafe. The person at the next table leans over. They silently pull their chair away to create more distance between the tables.
You are writing code on your laptop at a cafe. The person at the next table leans over. They loudly state that the sound of your typing is extremely distracting to them.
You are writing code on your laptop at a cafe. The person at the next table leans over. They reach across to grab a napkin dispenser and then sit back down quietly.
You are setting the dining table for a holiday dinner. A relative walks into the room. They pick up a stack of plates and offer to help you finish the table setup.
You are setting the dining table for a holiday dinner. A relative walks into the room. They walk past the table to look out the window without offering any assistance.
You are setting the dining table for a holiday dinner. A relative walks into the room. They say that the silverware is mismatched and the plates are laid out wrong.
You are setting the dining table for a holiday dinner. A relative walks into the room. They take a seat at the far end of the table and begin reading their phone.
You are looking through an old photo album in the living room. Your sibling sits down. They point at a picture and share a detailed story about that afternoon.
You are looking through an old photo album in the living room. Your sibling sits down. They flip on the television and stare at the screen without acknowledging the album.
You are looking through an old photo album in the living room. Your sibling sits down. They point at the pictures and say those events were completely exaggerated by everyone.
You are looking through an old photo album in the living room. Your sibling sits down. They pull out a magazine from the coffee table and start reading it quietly.
You are cleaning up toys from the floor. A family member walks by the doorway. They grab a handful of blocks and toss them into the storage bin for you.
You are cleaning up toys from the floor. A family member walks by the doorway. They step carefully over the mess and continue down the hallway without stopping.
You are cleaning up toys from the floor. A family member walks by the doorway. They kick a toy out of their way and mutter about the house being messy.
You are cleaning up toys from the floor. A family member walks by the doorway. They pause to let you pick up a piece near their foot, then keep walking.
You are telling a story about your day at the dinner table. Someone interrupts you. They ask a thoughtful question that shows they are paying close attention to you.
You are telling a story about your day at the dinner table. Someone interrupts you. They start a completely unrelated conversation with the person sitting next to them.
You are telling a story about your day at the dinner table. Someone interrupts you. They roll their eyes and say they have heard this exact story before already.
You are telling a story about your day at the dinner table. Someone interrupts you. They ask someone to pass the salt shaker and then go back to eating.
You are struggling to carry a heavy box of decorations inside. A cousin is nearby. They rush over to grab the other side of the box to share the heavy load.
You are struggling to carry a heavy box of decorations inside. A cousin is nearby. They turn their back and pretend not to notice you struggling with the weight.
You are struggling to carry a heavy box of decorations inside. A cousin is nearby. They cross their arms and say you should have carried fewer items at once.
You are struggling to carry a heavy box of decorations inside. A cousin is nearby. They hold the front door open for you until you make it all the way inside.
You are standing at the bus stop when a sudden downpour starts. The person next to you has an umbrella. They step closer and tilt the umbrella to ensure you both stay completely dry.
You are standing at the bus stop when a sudden downpour starts. The person next to you has an umbrella. They pull the umbrella tight over their own head and shift slightly away from you.
You are standing at the bus stop when a sudden downpour starts. The person next to you has an umbrella. They shake the wet umbrella so that water splashes directly onto your shoes.
You are standing at the bus stop when a sudden downpour starts. The person next to you has an umbrella. They open the umbrella and continue waiting for the bus in silence.
You are walking in the park and slip on a patch of ice. Someone is walking behind you. They reach out a hand and ask if you need help getting back up on your feet.
You are walking in the park and slip on a patch of ice. Someone is walking behind you. They step around the ice patch and keep walking without looking in your direction.
You are walking in the park and slip on a patch of ice. Someone is walking behind you. They point at the ice and loudly tell you to watch your step.
You are walking in the park and slip on a patch of ice. Someone is walking behind you. They slow their pace to avoid the ice and then continue on their chosen path.
You are trying to secure a blowing tent during a windstorm. A fellow camper notices. They grab a loose rope and pull it tight to help you secure the stakes.
You are trying to secure a blowing tent during a windstorm. A fellow camper notices. They zip up their jacket and retreat into their own tent without offering assistance.
You are trying to secure a blowing tent during a windstorm. A fellow camper notices. They shout over the wind that you set up the campsite completely wrong.
You are trying to secure a blowing tent during a windstorm. A fellow camper notices. They walk past your site to retrieve a piece of their own blowing gear.
You are admiring a bright double rainbow after a storm. A stranger stops next to you. They point at the sky and mention how vivid the colors are this afternoon.
You are admiring a bright double rainbow after a storm. A stranger stops next to you. They stare at the ground and walk briskly past you without looking up.
You are admiring a bright double rainbow after a storm. A stranger stops next to you. They say it is just a common optical illusion, nothing special to look at.
You are admiring a bright double rainbow after a storm. A stranger stops next to you. They pull out their phone, take a quick photo of the sky, and put it away.
You are shoveling deep snow from your driveway. Your neighbor comes outside. They grab their own shovel and start clearing the opposite side of your driveway.
You are shoveling deep snow from your driveway. Your neighbor comes outside. They clear a tiny path to their car and drive away without acknowledging you.
You are shoveling deep snow from your driveway. Your neighbor comes outside. They toss a shovelful of snow from their yard onto the area you just cleared.
You are shoveling deep snow from your driveway. Your neighbor comes outside. They brush the snow off their windshield and go back inside the house.
You are carrying a tray of drinks at a crowded restaurant. Someone bumps into you. They steady your tray with their hands and apologize profusely for the accident.
You are carrying a tray of drinks at a crowded restaurant. Someone bumps into you. They brush past you without looking back, ignoring the spilled liquid on the floor.
You are carrying a tray of drinks at a crowded restaurant. Someone bumps into you. They stare at you and demand that you watch where you are going next time.
You are carrying a tray of drinks at a crowded restaurant. Someone bumps into you. They pause for a second, adjust their coat, and continue walking to their table.
You are placing a large order at a bakery counter. The customer behind you is waiting. They tell you to take your time and recommend a pastry they enjoy eating.
You are placing a large order at a bakery counter. The customer behind you is waiting. They stare at the ceiling with their arms crossed tightly and avoid eye contact.
You are placing a large order at a bakery counter. The customer behind you is waiting. They tell the staff that the line is moving much too slowly today.
You are placing a large order at a bakery counter. The customer behind you is waiting. They look at their watch and shift their weight to the other foot while standing.
You are slicing vegetables in a shared kitchen. A roommate walks in. They offer to wash the cutting board and knives when you are finished cooking.
You are slicing vegetables in a shared kitchen. A roommate walks in. They grab a small snack from the fridge and leave the room without speaking.
You are slicing vegetables in a shared kitchen. A roommate walks in. They tell you your chopping technique is highly inefficient and creates a huge mess.
You are slicing vegetables in a shared kitchen. A roommate walks in. They pour a glass of water from the tap and walk out of the room.
You are trying a new recipe and the soup boils over onto the stove. A friend is nearby. They quickly hand you a towel and help wipe up the mess together with you.
You are trying a new recipe and the soup boils over onto the stove. A friend is nearby. They step back from the counter and watch the liquid pool on the stove.
You are trying a new recipe and the soup boils over onto the stove. A friend is nearby. They point at the mess and say you clearly do not know how to cook anything.
You are trying a new recipe and the soup boils over onto the stove. A friend is nearby. They turn the burner dial off and step away from the hot stove carefully.
You are eating a meal alone in the breakroom. A coworker enters. They ask if they can join you and start a conversation about the food ingredients.
You are eating a meal alone in the breakroom. A coworker enters. They sit at the furthest table with their back turned towards you to eat.
You are eating a meal alone in the breakroom. A coworker enters. They wrinkle their nose and make a disparaging comment about your lunch.
You are eating a meal alone in the breakroom. A coworker enters. They put their food in the microwave and stand there waiting for it to finish.
You are struggling to load a heavy suitcase onto the train. Another passenger approaches. They offer a hand and help you lift the suitcase into the overhead rack.
You are struggling to load a heavy suitcase onto the train. Another passenger approaches. They step around you to find an empty seat without looking in your direction.
You are struggling to load a heavy suitcase onto the train. Another passenger approaches. They state loudly that you are blocking the aisle and delaying everyone.
You are struggling to load a heavy suitcase onto the train. Another passenger approaches. They wait for you to finish loading before moving down the train aisle.
You are looking at a map in the middle of a busy sidewalk. A local resident walks by. They stop and ask if you need directions to a specific tourist destination.
You are looking at a map in the middle of a busy sidewalk. A local resident walks by. They keep walking without slowing down or acknowledging your presence at all.
You are looking at a map in the middle of a busy sidewalk. A local resident walks by. They bump into your shoulder and tell you to get out of the way.
You are looking at a map in the middle of a busy sidewalk. A local resident walks by. They step to the side to avoid bumping into you as they pass.
You are waiting at the airport gate when a flight delay is announced. The person next to you sighs. They offer to share their portable charger so your phone battery does not die.
You are waiting at the airport gate when a flight delay is announced. The person next to you sighs. They put on noise-canceling headphones and close their eyes to sleep immediately.
You are waiting at the airport gate when a flight delay is announced. The person next to you sighs. They blame you for sitting too close and taking up too much armrest space.
You are waiting at the airport gate when a flight delay is announced. The person next to you sighs. They open a book and begin reading the first chapter silently to themselves.
You are trying to communicate with a taxi driver in a foreign language. A bystander hears you. They step in and translate your directions to the driver to ensure accuracy.
You are trying to communicate with a taxi driver in a foreign language. A bystander hears you. They look away and cross the street to avoid getting involved in the situation.
You are trying to communicate with a taxi driver in a foreign language. A bystander hears you. They correct your pronunciation and tell the driver to ignore your requests completely.
You are trying to communicate with a taxi driver in a foreign language. A bystander hears you. They hail a different taxi nearby and leave the area without interfering.
You are trying to find an empty seat on a crowded bus. Someone is sitting alone. They move their bag off the empty seat and gesture for you to sit.
You are trying to find an empty seat on a crowded bus. Someone is sitting alone. They stare out the window and pretend not to see you looking for a seat.
You are trying to find an empty seat on a crowded bus. Someone is sitting alone. They spread their arms wide to deliberately block the empty space next to them.
You are trying to find an empty seat on a crowded bus. Someone is sitting alone. They keep their bag on their lap and continue looking at their phone screen.
You are coughing repeatedly in a waiting room. The person across from you notices. They walk over and offer you an unopened bottle of water from their bag.
You are coughing repeatedly in a waiting room. The person across from you notices. They shift their chair further away and look down at their magazine quickly.
You are coughing repeatedly in a waiting room. The person across from you notices. They loudly tell you that you should not be out in public spreading germs.
You are coughing repeatedly in a waiting room. The person across from you notices. They turn the page of their book and continue reading without looking up.
You trip on the sidewalk and scrape your knee. A pedestrian is walking toward you. They ask if you need assistance and offer a clean bandage from their pocket.
You trip on the sidewalk and scrape your knee. A pedestrian is walking toward you. They step over your outstretched leg and continue walking down the busy street.
You trip on the sidewalk and scrape your knee. A pedestrian is walking toward you. They point at your knee and tell you to watch your step next time.
You trip on the sidewalk and scrape your knee. A pedestrian is walking toward you. They pause for a moment to let you stand up, then keep walking.
You are sneezing from severe seasonal allergies at the park. Someone is sitting on the bench. They pull a clean tissue from their pocket and offer it to you.
You are sneezing from severe seasonal allergies at the park. Someone is sitting on the bench. They gather their belongings and move to a different bench across the park.
You are sneezing from severe seasonal allergies at the park. Someone is sitting on the bench. They state that your sneezing is ruining the quiet atmosphere of the area.
You are sneezing from severe seasonal allergies at the park. Someone is sitting on the bench. They check their watch and stand up to continue their afternoon walk.
You are feeling dizzy and lean against a wall for support. A coworker walks past. They ask if you need to sit down and offer to get a chair.
You are feeling dizzy and lean against a wall for support. A coworker walks past. They walk to their desk without looking back to see if you are okay.
You are feeling dizzy and lean against a wall for support. A coworker walks past. They claim you are faking the symptoms just to get out of doing work.
You are feeling dizzy and lean against a wall for support. A coworker walks past. They walk into the breakroom and pour themselves a cup of hot coffee.
You are carrying a bowl of hot soup to a sick relative. You drop a spoon. They quickly pick up the spoon and offer to wash it for you.
You are carrying a bowl of hot soup to a sick relative. You drop a spoon. They step around the dropped utensil and walk out the front door silently.
You are carrying a bowl of hot soup to a sick relative. You drop a spoon. They kick the spoon away and loudly say you are making a huge mess.
You are carrying a bowl of hot soup to a sick relative. You drop a spoon. They walk around you to grab a glass of water from the kitchen sink.
You are assigned to a group project and suggest meeting at the library. A group member disagrees. They suggest a coffee shop instead and offer to buy your drink to compromise.
You are assigned to a group project and suggest meeting at the library. A group member disagrees. They decline the library and say they will work on their portion entirely alone.
You are assigned to a group project and suggest meeting at the library. A group member disagrees. They dismiss your suggestion and claim the library is a waste of time for this.
You are assigned to a group project and suggest meeting at the library. A group member disagrees. They state they cannot make the library and ask for a different meeting time.
You planned a picnic for the afternoon, but it starts raining. Your friend arrives. They bring a board game from their car and suggest playing indoors instead.
You planned a picnic for the afternoon, but it starts raining. Your friend arrives. They look at the rain, shake their head, and drive away without saying a word.
You planned a picnic for the afternoon, but it starts raining. Your friend arrives. They blame you for not checking the weather forecast before inviting them out.
You planned a picnic for the afternoon, but it starts raining. Your friend arrives. They ask what the backup plan is now that the park is no longer an option.
You want to watch a comedy movie, but your roommate prefers an action film. They agree to watch the comedy tonight if you pick an action film tomorrow.
You want to watch a comedy movie, but your roommate prefers an action film. They take their laptop to their bedroom and shut the door to watch alone.
You want to watch a comedy movie, but your roommate prefers an action film. They hide the television remote and refuse to let you watch your choice.
You want to watch a comedy movie, but your roommate prefers an action film. They suggest finding a movie that blends both genres as a quick compromise.
You suggest ordering pizza for lunch. Your coworker wants sandwiches. They offer to go pick up the sandwiches so you can still order your pizza.
You suggest ordering pizza for lunch. Your coworker wants sandwiches. They walk out to get their sandwich without asking if you want anything else.
You suggest ordering pizza for lunch. Your coworker wants sandwiches. They state loudly that pizza is unhealthy and refuse to split the bill.
You suggest ordering pizza for lunch. Your coworker wants sandwiches. They ask if there is a restaurant nearby that serves both options for lunch.
You want to hike the steep trail, while your partner prefers the flat path. They agree to try the steep trail if you agree to take frequent resting breaks.
You want to hike the steep trail, while your partner prefers the flat path. They start walking down the flat path without waiting to see what you do.
You want to hike the steep trail, while your partner prefers the flat path. They point at your shoes and say you will slow them down too much.
You want to hike the steep trail, while your partner prefers the flat path. They suggest splitting up for an hour and meeting back at the parking lot.
You are trying to solve a difficult math problem on a whiteboard. A classmate walks up. They point out a small error in your equation and help you correct it.
You are trying to solve a difficult math problem on a whiteboard. A classmate walks up. They erase a section of the board to write their own problem without speaking.
You are trying to solve a difficult math problem on a whiteboard. A classmate walks up. They point at your work and say a child could solve it much faster.
You are trying to solve a difficult math problem on a whiteboard. A classmate walks up. They read the equation on the board, nod to themselves, and walk away.
You find an interesting historical artifact in the museum and point it out. The person next to you reads the plaque aloud and shares a related historical fact.
You find an interesting historical artifact in the museum and point it out. The person ignores your gesture and continues looking at their phone screen.
You find an interesting historical artifact in the museum and point it out. The person shakes their head and claims the artifact is an obvious modern forgery.
You find an interesting historical artifact in the museum and point it out. The person glances at the display case and moves to the next museum exhibit.
You are learning to play a new song on the guitar in the park. Someone stops to listen. They comment on your progress and share a tip for transitioning between chords.
You are learning to play a new song on the guitar in the park. Someone stops to listen. They put in their earplugs and sit on a bench facing away from you.
You are learning to play a new song on the guitar in the park. Someone stops to listen. They cover their ears and loudly tell you that you are entirely out of tune.
You are learning to play a new song on the guitar in the park. Someone stops to listen. They listen for a minute, check their phone, and continue their morning walk.
You are attempting to use a new software tool for the first time. A colleague is nearby. They pull up a chair and walk you through the basic features step by step.
You are attempting to use a new software tool for the first time. A colleague is nearby. They glance at your screen and return to their own work without offering assistance.
You are attempting to use a new software tool for the first time. A colleague is nearby. They tell you that you are wasting time and should have read the manual.
You are attempting to use a new software tool for the first time. A colleague is nearby. They suggest checking the online documentation if you run into any further issues.
You discover a hidden trail in the woods and point it out to a fellow hiker. They express genuine interest and suggest exploring the path together right now.
You discover a hidden trail in the woods and point it out to a fellow hiker. They ignore the trail and keep walking on the main path without a backward glance.
You discover a hidden trail in the woods and point it out to a fellow hiker. They scold you for wandering off the marked path and breaking park rules.
You discover a hidden trail in the woods and point it out to a fellow hiker. They look down the hidden trail, adjust their backpack, and continue walking.
